The '''Unification War''' was a [[civil war]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] that resulted in the unification of the [[Tapani Noble Houses]]. The conflict lasted nearly twenty years.

==Background==
[[File:Unification_war_re-enactment.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Reenactment of the Battle of Shindra's Veil prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]
The [[Tapani Noble Houses|Twelve Kingdoms]] existed in the Tapani sector for 3,000 years after power was devolved from the [[Pella Compact]].

[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Shey Tapani]] of the [[House Melantha|Melanthian Kingdom]] desired to unite the twelve kingdoms once again and initiated a series of conflicts with the other kingdoms. Forces of the [[Rogue Houses|opposing houses]] were ultimately defeated at the [[Battle of Shindra's Veil]].

==Aftermath==
The defeat of the Rogue Houses allowed Shey Tapani to unite the sector under the [[Tapani Empire]]. Tapani crowned himself [[Emperor (Tapani)|Emperor]] of the new dominion, ushering the [[Dynastic Era]] which lasted until [[1582 BBY]].

[[House Nidantha]] was one of two noble houses that were destroyed during this conflict, and another was absorbed within a century.<ref name="Player" />

[[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] was established as the new capital of the Tapani sector.

==Legacy==
The war was subsequently commemorated by the Tapani noble houses at the [[Unification Gala]], which included a reenactment of the final battle, well into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
